name: PDFForge Studio v1.2.0 (Native Rust Edition)
notes: PDFForge Studio v1.2.0: Acrobat-grade Rust text selection & object editing, Ctrl+Tab & pointer drag-and-drop tabs with per-tab view state restoration, responsive DPI-safe Print dialog with duplex & paper scaling, offline bundled & Bangla fonts, Adobe Acrobat context menus, smooth touchpad two-finger pinch zoom in normal & fullscreen modes, and fixed Combine Files dialog controls.
